description.value: Health Essentials is a community-oriented health and wellness shop founded in 2011 by a Victoria couple, located at the corner of Tillicum and Gorge Road West directly across from Gorge Waterway Park. The store carries a curated selection of supplements, specialty foods (local organic meats, dairy, keto items), barefoot shoes, light therapy products, and natural body care. It hosts educational seminars and workshops and ships Canada-wide, with a loyal local following drawn by its knowledgeable staff and competitive pricing.
